channel.title: Services on KubeSphere
channel.description: Recent content in Services on KubeSphere

item.title: Create a Service
item.description: This section describes how to create a Service. Prerequisites You need to join a cluster and have the Application Workload Management permission in the cluster. For more information, see Cluster Members and Cluster Roles. Steps Log in to the KubeSphere web console with a user who has Application Workload Management permissions and enter your cluster. Click Application Workloads > Services in the left navigation pane.

item.title: View Service List
item.description: This section describes how to view the service list. Prerequisites You need to join a cluster and have the Application Workloads View permission in the cluster. For more information, see Cluster Members and Cluster Roles. Steps Log in to the KubeSphere web console with a user who has Application Workloads View permissions and enter your cluster. Click Application Workloads > Services in the left navigation pane.

item.title: View Service Details
item.description: This section describes how to view service details. Prerequisites You need to join a cluster and have the Application Workloads View permission in the cluster. For more information, see Cluster Members and Cluster Roles. Steps Log in to the KubeSphere web console with a user who has Application Workloads View permissions and enter your cluster. Click Application Workloads > Service in the left navigation pane.

item.title: Edit Service Information
item.description: This section describes how to edit Job information. You can edit the alias and description of a Job. KubeSphere does not support editing the name of a created Job. Prerequisites You need to join a cluster and have the Application Workload Management permission in the cluster. For more information, see Cluster Members and Cluster Roles. Steps Log in to the KubeSphere web console with a user who has Application Workload Management permissions and enter your cluster.

item.title: Edit Service Settings
item.description: This section describes how to edit Job settings. Prerequisites You need to join a cluster and have the Application Workload Management permission in the cluster. For more information, see Cluster Members and Cluster Roles. Steps Log in to the KubeSphere web console with a user who has Application Workload Management permissions and enter your cluster. Click Application Workloads > Service in the left navigation pane.

item.title: Edit Service External Access Settings
item.description: This section describes how to edit the service external access settings. Note This operation is only supported for services with the internal access mode set to VirtualIP. It is not supported for services with the internal access modes Headless or ExternalName. Prerequisites You need to join a cluster and have the Application Workload Management permission in the cluster.

item.title: Delete Services
item.description: This section describes how to delete a service. Warning After deleting the service, you will not be able to access the pods behind it. Please perform this operation with caution. Prerequisites You need to join a cluster and have the Application Workload Management permission in the cluster. For more information, see Cluster Members and Cluster Roles.
